$comment: City of Zürich (BFS-Nr 261, canton ZH) — BZO zone-parameter catalogue. Founder-supplied,
transcribed from the BZO 700.100 primary PDFs and cross-checked (Z5–Z7 AZ 200/230/260%
independently corroborated against the Stadt Zürich BZO summary). This is a TRANSCRIPTION,
NOT a live authoritative feed — every value ships confidence `estimated-ruleset`, never
`structured`. It is the HUMAN-facing verification artefact; the machine catalogue that the
resolver reads is the typed transcription in
packages/site-parcel-data/src/providers/chZurichBzoCatalogue.ts, which cites THIS file and is
parity-guarded by chZurichBzoCatalogue.test.ts. NO number here may reach a rendered envelope
until CH_FAR_CERTIFIED is flipped ON by the repo owner (see VERIFICATION.md).
azUnitNote: Ausnützungsziffer (AZ) is transcribed as a fraction of parcel area; the PDF states it as a percentage (e.g. 45% -> 0.45). Max GFA = AZ * parcel area.
regimeNote: TWO PARALLEL REGIMES govern different plan areas of the city. The value that applies to a
parcel depends on WHICH regime governs it — resolvable from the parcel's rechtsvorschrift_url /
plan area, NOT the zone-code string alone. See resolveZurichBzoRegime(). If the regime cannot be
determined for a parcel, the resolver REFUSES that parcel ('regime-ambiguous') and never guesses.

bzo_91_99.title: Bau- und Zonenordnung der Stadt Zürich (BZO 1991/1999)
bzo_91_99.urlStatus: founder-supplied-primary-pdf — confirm exact consolidated-PDF URL at sign-off (oerebdocs getDoc base verified live 2026-07-25; the per-parcel rechtsvorschrift_url links the governing document)
bzo_91_99.coverage: the older regime — most of the city

bzo_2016.title: 700.100 Bau- und Zonenordnung der Stadt Zürich (BZO 2016)
bzo_2016.urlStatus: founder-supplied-primary-pdf — confirm exact consolidated-PDF URL at sign-off; Amtliche Sammlung 700.100 (oerebdocs getDoc base verified live 2026-07-25)

discrepancies.why_it_matters: The AZ is identical (0.45) across both regimes, but the max Gebäudehöhe differs (8.5 m vs 9.0 m). A parcel's height cap therefore CANNOT be chosen from the zone code alone — the governing regime must be resolved first. This is the canonical case that makes per-parcel regime resolution soundness-critical.

bzo_2016.label: BZO 2016
bzo_2016.coverageNote: Only the zones the founder cross-checked under BZO 2016 are transcribed here. Zones absent from this regime block are deliberately NOT carried — no BZO 2016 value was supplied for them, and none is guessed.

W2bIII.discrepancyNote: Höhe 9.0 m here vs 8.5 m under BZO 91/99; AZ unchanged at 0.45.
